en.html:
That, more or less, was what Captain Ootori had brought back from Yokohama. Written version for the Chief, spoken version also.

For some time, no reply came out of me. The others appeared similarly supplied with nothing to say. Only the Chief's fingertips turning the pages disturbed the silence settled in the air.

A top-secret Rokuhara weapons experiment.

In the present situation, possible? Certainly possible. But still—

en.html:
Kanae"'I saw a silver monster'? We are not writing a horror novel, na. A professional investigator, and this is the report he sends?"
Kageaki"I too think it is excessively lyrical."
Kanae"And then a weapons experiment, and a request for police cooperation. ...Well, taken separately, neither is particularly suspicious."
Kageaki"Yes."
Kanae"Put them together, though, and the sense goes missing. For an investigation highly confidential even for the investigators themselves, outside help they want?"
Kageaki"The explanation given was a shortage of suitable personnel, but..."
Kanae"Since wartime the League has had plenty of local agents. Today how things stand, I cannot claim to know... But this 'shortage of manpower,' somehow I cannot make myself believe it."

景明「叙情的に過ぎるとは自分も思います」
香奈枝「それに、兵器実験。警察局への協力要請。 　……まぁ別個に見れば、これといって不審 なことはないにしても」
景明「ええ」
香奈枝「二つ合わせると何ともはや。 　どうしてそんな探る側にとっても機密性の・・・・・・・・・・・・ 高い・・調査に外部の協力を頼むのでしょう？」
景明「適切な人材が不足している、とのご説明で したが……」
香奈枝「連盟は戦時中から多数の現地工作員を確保 していましてよ？　今の実情について詳しい わけではありませんけど……人手不足という のはどうも、リアリティを感じませんね」

en.html:
The Captain frowned. Doubt about her own organization, she was stating it openly. Embarrassment? Not troubling her at all.

For my part, this attitude of hers I thought we could trust. The Prince and the Chief apparently could not avoid looking for the intention underneath. Somewhat cold looks went her way. From their mouths, still nothing.

en.html:
Kageaki"Captain, one direct question. Have you received any other explanation for this matter?"
Kanae"Not a thing. Such an urgent summons—what has happened, I wonder, and off to Yokohama I go. There, this bundle of paper they put in my hands. Bas."
Kanae"Apparently my superior has yet to discover this system called the mail. Such a backward fellow I have been given."
Sayo"For classified information, that is the proper procedure. Still, proper nonsense it is also."
Kageaki"...They want the Police Bureau's help to investigate Rokuhara weapons research. For that proposal to stand, the shogunate and the Police Bureau must first be regarded as separate. On this point, what is the position?"
Kanae"The friendship between His Highness Prince Maidono and the Chief of Kamakura Station, and how both gentlemen worry over Yamato's present condition—I have already reported all that."

en.html:
Perfectly suspicious. Not one defect in the suspiciousness.

The three of us reached this same conclusion and let our eyes wander into empty air.

Peace and order for this island country: that was the occupation army's stated purpose. To increase our faith in it, the dim ceiling offered precisely nothing. We looked. No assistance came.

Suspicion and doubt only, going round and round.

en.html:
Prince Maidono"Achha. So a trap they have arranged for us?"
Chief"Yes. Whatever waits on Enoshima, we may safely take its purpose to be Kageaki's capture or killing."
Chief"Captain? Your view?"
Kanae"Entirely agreed. Since I heard this story, the hair on the back of my neck simply will not lie down. Full attention. Every last hair."
Kanae"Here, Kageaki. See for yourself, na."
Kageaki"Yes?"
Sayo"Decorum, madam. Some decorum."
Prince Maidono"D-decorum is being lost?! Where?! Arre, this bloody blind! Nothing I can see!"
Kanae"Kageaki... touching is permitted also, you know?"
Kageaki"Then I shall take the liberty."
Chief"...Later. Since the Captain also has no objection, we may conclude that this is a trap."
Chief"Either decline with carefully chosen words, or accept on paper and do precisely nothing in practice. Sabotage, in short. Either course should serve, Your Highness."
Prince Maidono"Haan, that will do. Kageaki, settled like this, no?"
Kageaki"No."
Prince Maidono"Aiyyo!?"
Chief"...Kageaki."
Kageaki"To Enoshima I will go. Your Highness, the secret order for my release on bail, please."
Kanae"Secret order... for bail?"
Kageaki"A little complication is attached. Please consider yourself not to have heard."
Kanae"Understood♪"
Sayo"Show obedience, collect goodwill at discount rate. Very good going, madam."
Chief"Kageaki... what are you thinking? You believe this is not a trap?"
Kageaki"Everything being exactly as stated—that possibility also I do not rule out."
Chief"You are serious?"

ja.html:
舞殿宮「で、罠を仕掛けてきたっちゅうことか」
署長「はい。 　江ノ島に何が待つにしろ、その目的とする 所は景明の捕殺とみて間違いないでしょう」
署長「如何ですか？ 　大尉」
香奈枝「まったく賛成いたします。 　わたくしもこの話を聞いた時から、うなじ の毛が逆立ちっぱなしで仕方ありませんし。 それはもうびんびんに」
香奈枝「ほら、景明さま。 　ご覧下さいましな」
景明「は」
さよ「はしたないですよ、お嬢さま」
舞殿宮「は、はしたないことやってるんか!? 　くはッ、スダレが邪魔でよう見えん！」
香奈枝「景明さま…… 　触ってもよろしいんですのよ？」
景明「では、失礼して」
署長「……後にしろ。 　大尉からも異論がないのであれば、この件 は罠と断定して差し支え無し」
署長「言葉を選んで断るか、あるいは表面上受け 入れておいて実質は何もしない……要はサボ タージュを決め込むか。 　いずれかで宜しかろうと存じます。宮殿下」
舞殿宮「そやねえ。 　景明くん、それでええね？」
景明「いいえ」
舞殿宮「おうっち!?」
署長「……景明」
景明「自分は江ノ島へ向かいます。 　宮殿下、保釈の密旨をお下しあれ」
香奈枝「ほしゃくの……みつじ？」
景明「少々差し障りがありますので、お聞き流し 下さい」
香奈枝「わかりました♪」
さよ「素直さをアピールしてせこく好感度ゲット。 　良い感じですよお嬢さま」
署長「景明……どういうつもりだ。 　罠ではないと思うのか？」
景明「全てが額面通りという可能性も否定はしま せん」
署長「本気か」

Prince Maidono"So a trap they have arranged?"
Chief"Yes. Whatever waits on Enoshima, its purpose is almost certainly Kageaki's capture or killing. In that case, our response..."
Chief"Either decline with carefully chosen words, or accept on paper and do precisely nothing in practice. Sabotage, in short. Either course should serve, Your Highness."
Prince Maidono"Haan, that will do. Kageaki, settled like this, no?"
Kageaki"No."
Prince Maidono"Aiyyo!?"
Chief"...Kageaki."
Kageaki"To Enoshima I will go. Your Highness, the secret order for my release on bail, please."
Prince Maidono"Arre, no, no. That will not do..."
Chief"...What are you thinking? You believe this is not a trap?"
Kageaki"Everything being exactly as stated—that possibility also I do not rule out."
Chief"You are serious?"

Chief"............Your Highness."
Prince Maidono"............Kya karein, then...?"
Chief"Yes... With this man, not yet... For now."
Kageaki"..."
Prince Maidono"Be careful, Kageaki. Bahut sambhal ke. Very carefully..."
Kageaki"Your concern, I am deeply grateful for it."
Prince Maidono"...Dying you must not do, haan."
Kageaki"............Yes, Your Highness."
